title: Age of Empires IV
provenance: The r3 release was checked with Steam build 26559323, D3DMetal and MSync on an Apple M2 Max with macOS 27.2.1 (2026-11-17). Installation, Windows boot and Late Siege gameplay were verified locally; smaller stutters remain.
notes: The opt-in recipe selects the published AoE IV r3 engine with Rosetta on macOS 26 or later. Apply the fix on the game’s page, then launch with Play in Highball. If a graphics driver warning appears, click OK to continue.
